publication_basis: New direct model Kyrgyz-to-English translation of traditional epic narrative. No MT API or previous published English poem used. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian dictionary entries and original Kyrgyz editorial preface used only for lexical support. Provisional translation and lineation; source witness not reconciled and no independent expert certification.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0506:b003:l001: Page review: Kanykey speaks of her duel with Chubak. Twelve body parts at 4:9 are anatomical, not age twelve. Primary Yudakhin кыякчы fiddler, аякчы cupbearer, кыз накыштуу girls' favorite, ак ийин an eagle variety, бакала watch. Bird varieties are not assigned modern species beyond the evidence. 4:30 remains wholly unresolved. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. All material notes describe this page, not solely this first verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0507:b003:l001: Page review: Oygut and Akbaltay cries retained as printed, not silently normalized to Noygut. 3:9 refers to her father's drum. Primary мушта- includes a spear or knife strike, so 5:2 does not add a fist. Printed Туз at 3:32 and кымпыйтып at 3:34 remain unresolved; no correction to түз or generic grip-firmly. Wraps 3:3–4 and 3:22–23 are single printed verses. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. All material notes describe this page, not solely this first verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0508:b003:l001: Page review: spear-duel мушта retains weapon-strike sense; no fist added. Була at 3:3 retains general fiber sense, without claiming armor or wood splinters. Chubak's spear explicitly shatters into eighty. Capturing him for a glad-news reward is retained as narrated. At 4:37 printed Эр differs from nearby Өр and remains unresolved rather than silently changing to uphill. Wraps 4:10–11 and 4:12–13 joined. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0509:b003:l001: Page review: primary казгалдак wild duck, ызгыт=ызгыч lapwing, дөмөр marsh hummock, буурсун plow. 3:29 омуроо какты means intimidation/blustering, not literal chest-thrusting. 4:8 зайыпбуруш mighty renowned hero follows the Bakchiev glossary, not a shape-changing saint. 4:9 follows twelve spiritual masters, exact Yudakhin кол. 4:13 укурук кайрар withstand an enemy. 4:15 шай колдогон is favored with victory, exact шай III, not a generic holy man. Куу/ears at 3:22 and twelve-kylym formula at 4:12 remain unresolved. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0510:b003:l001: Page review: Zulpukor is retained as a weapon name; 3:29 explicitly calls it a spear, not silently a sword. Primary сан III санды кетир disgrace at 4:7, not hurt a thigh. White wheat flour chewing is the oath ritual, and келеме шарып is a sacred Quran-based oath. The two star imperatives at 4:21/28 remain unresolved; printed боз is not changed to дос. Wraps 3:14–15 and 4:37–38 joined. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0511:b003:l001: Page review: primary багалак II=абалак is the horn striker used in the ordo knucklebone game. 3:5 Oluyat's son is supported by Manas Encyclopedia I БАКАЙ: Oluyat fostered orphan Bakay in Zhelpinish; no biological-parent claim. The apparent identity formulation at 3:36 remains unresolved. Before-birth wording and seven/six/five/thirty-one figures are retained. Primary урлуу=нурлуу=нурдуу radiant at 4:15, not an emended word. Олуят at 4:22 is excellent applied to the sister-in-law. Printed күйө at 4:3 and time construction at 4:5 remain unresolved. Four indented continuations are joined. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0512:b003:l001: Page review: Kumayyk is the dog's name; betrothal earrings are explicit. Primary бардигер all available at 3:22, not Almighty. Twelve generations gathered at 3:39 is retained literally. Primary ык I exact horse-fat/strong formula. Шай колдогон at 4:5 is victory-favored. Аалым are religious scholars. Printed ике at 4:22 is the marriage rite нике with initial consonant omitted; raw unchanged. Буттаган is pood weight, not feet. Жеңкетай are groom's gifts to elder women relatives assisting the bride. Primary жазайыл quotes this exact sleeping-refusal scene as causing sorrow, not placing a firearm on a neck. Miraculous blade movement is not rationalized. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0513:b003:l001: Page review: салбар means neglected wife, supported by the 1960 Semetey glossary; ардык means resentment. Өлгөндө in marriage/birth recollections means at long last after suffering, not marriage or birth while dead. 3:30 жок нерсе and 3:34 printed саз remain unresolved rather than adding unknown-history or silently changing to сааз. Бейпай at 5:7 means distress. Capital Shai at 5:39 is the unseen protector, Yudakhin шай III. Quail/currant eyes and whip-length tears retained. Block 4 is a printer signature; right column is block 5. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0514:b003:l001: Page review: primary ириңде fester and кирилде wheeze. Printed parenthetical 3:26–31 is verse, not excluded commentary; Urmeke is retained as a capitalized personal form without asserting an identity. Бок expletive is preserved. Коен туяк remains unresolved; adjacent staff does not justify inventing an object. Sixty-locative/forty-sheep price construction at 4:21 remains unresolved. Grief-driven self-harm is translated as narrated, without additional actions. Stopper image at 4:32 remains literal. Балтыр бешик is a nursing infant. Mourning cheek-tearing is explicit. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0515:b003:l001: Page review: primary туу II barren is retained in the noble-horse metaphor, rather than inventing unburdened. Туйгун is a white goshawk; source gray-and-white modifier retained. Болпоң is an affectionate plump child. Printed алар at 3:23 is not silently changed to өлөр. Сооп means a religious good deed. Бири тирүү Таласым remains unresolved. Арышта means stride, not lament. Thirty-day vow remains distinct from Kanykey's earlier sixty-day instruction. Block 4 is a printer signature; right column block 5. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0516:b003:l001: Page review: primary кан ыйла at 3:5 means weep blood, not the title khan. Primary касаба exact banner-fluttering formula; white-hoofed mare is pledged in prayer, no actual slaughter added. Printed мннгени is the riding/mount form in context; raw preserved. Менде is mortal. Exact Yudakhin эки семиз күч quotes two fat working horses; source two milk skins retained despite dictionary parallel six. Elliptical widows/one-bone-of-meat construction retained without inventing an offering action. Илеп is breath/emanation. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0517:b003:l001: Page review: сыйнат=зыйнат splendor. Primary literal аты кашка / атасы башка supports the white-blazed-horse/different-father contrast. Twig-cutting euphemism retained in ritual context without additional procedures. Twelve spiritual masters formula retained at 4:17. Олуят blessing at 4:16 remains unresolved between personal and epithet readings. Infant-flight буласын булап at 3:29 and сандан кетип at 4:35 remain unresolved; clear plunder elsewhere does not decide these constructions. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0518:b003:l001: Page review: primary чар IV rook quotes the exact snow-mountains/forest-rooks formula. Hogweed stems, deer, argali and snowcock comparisons retained without added subspecies. Hearing/leaving negations in nightingale verses preserved. Both Bukhara departure at 3:34 and Talas departure at 4:1 retained, without harmonization. Керүү is upland pasture. Көлкүлдө means swollen and soft, exact waterskin comparison. Plane-tree milk is narrated literally. Баймакта means tether by one foreleg. Каңкы is a saddle. Ач болот is a sharp sword. Кутба direction at 4:36 remains unresolved despite adjacent qibla. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0519:b003:l001: Page review: кара көк is an unyielding warrior epithet. Born to surpass Manas comparison retained. Yudakhin Тараза жылдыз is the Scales constellation; its setting marks dawn in the quoted idiom, with no modern astronomical calculation claimed. Амаз initial-n-less prayer, ирекет prayer cycle and багымдат dawn prayer translated. Shared horse/rider foot position and qibla direction retained as printed. Mountain/town angular haze imagery not silently replaced. Mother's warning is to avoid Kokand if possible. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0520:b003:l001: Page review: primary бил I is elephant, with exact билге жүктөп loading on an elephant. Dark-eyed captives are not assigned sex. Күпчөк is a leather bucket; акуш is a song; алеңгир elsewhere is not a poison ingredient. Primary жүрөгүнүн сары суусун ал means terrify; yellow-water image retained with this sense noted. Баанала=маанала take cover. Зыңгыра majestic, not hum. Kushbegi rendered high official: 2015 Kyrgyz dictionary establishes a high Kokand office, not specifically Bukhara's chief-minister role. 3:22 restored from full Yudakhin элчилик sense 3 reconciliation. Two wraps joined. Primary lexical evidence: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf and research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json; Semetey 1960 glossary aid and research/SEMETEY-1960-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0521:b003:l001: Page review: double mail with lark-eye rings preserved; келеме II collar has gold-thread embroidery. Кисе is a belt bearing pouches. Мураап here inherited object. Медиян is desolate, not the city Medina. Six Cities is the regional label; alternative heavenly/plundered belt origins are both retained with their source attribution. Primary бачагар=баччагар scoundrel and кызагар same insult, without asserting illegitimate birth. Dateless age twelve remains explicit. Plow-turning image retained literally. Printer signature block 4 excluded; right column block 5. Чогоол мылтык is a fearsome gun, exact primary; no firearm mechanism invented. Тындым кыл means kill. Жылас is a curse for doomed fellows here. Gate-like teeth and repeated chewing retained. Born-to-surpass comparison remains distinct from posthumous birth. Өрттөнгүр curse does not assert historical burning. Көлкөй bulky form, not serenity. Датка is a high dignitary rank; no exact governor office added. Broad-lunged/wheezing and thunderous horse images retained. Кара бас is evil-spirit affliction, contrasted with comic childbirth comparison. Separate ten-spearman and ten-swordsman actions retained. Printer signature block 4 excluded; right column block 5. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0524:b003:l001: Page review: primary тепейт exact blue overshoes protruding at stirrups. Printed чекейт and чепейт remain unresolved rather than corrected to кекейт. Очогор is an epic mighty gun; no twelve-shot specification added. Зыңылда hum differs from зыңгыра majestic. Алеңгир I is havoc, not a projectile or Joloy's sword. Curly beard бужугур primary. Этине келди remains unresolved rather than correcting to эсине. 4:13 restored as piebald-horse theft denial after 525 parallel with dun horse and primary ала/кула. Father-grave curse retained. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0525:b003:l001: Page review: primary ала piebald horse and кула dun horse resolve the paired theft questions; not slave or unspecified valuables. Exact эмгегиң кара төбөңө curse returns suffering to the offender. Чалгыртта stubborn. Ten, four-or-five, six-or-seven, sixty and about-sixty figures retained without forcing arithmetic agreement. Укурук кайрар means someone able to withstand an enemy. No-lament-over-dead wording does not add a separate mourner. Чом is camel saddle. Final verse continues into next page.
